name: kenka_bath_notice
screen: Minigame "Kenka Yamete" (bath-house, small notice at right edge, scrolled in)
meaning: Notice board (bath rules / prices?) — too small to read
compression: none (raw NGPC 2bpp tiles, 16 bytes per 8x8 tile)

map.entry: VRAM map entry = ROM word + 0x100 (tile base; tile index = word & 0x1FF counts from the start of the tile block)
map.loader: screen table record 0x1C0394 (pointer list at 0x1C0000): +0 map ptr, +4 tile ptr, +8 w, +10 h, +12 tile count, +14 flags

cells_format: [tile, palette, hflip, vflip] row by row

png_index_map.note: transparent (colour 0 of every palette); shown as the screen backdrop colour

max_size.note: Stay inside the 32x24 px area. The tile block holds 206 tiles; tiles listed in shared_with_rest_of_screen are also used outside this area and must not change (or the map must be repointed to free tiles).
